newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - May 1.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Customs detain two Airlanka employees trying to smuggle in 70 gold biscuits valued at six million rupees.
Political parties and labour unions to hold May Day rallies in north and east after a lapse of several years.
Canada plans to send back 200 Sri Lankan Tamil refugees who sought asylum after giving false information about the situation in the island.
Apparel exporters want local production of imported inputs to raise value-addition to up to 60 percent from only 40 percent now.
Asian Development Bank to open resident mission in Sri Lanka.
Sri Lankan navy detects and chases away Indian trawlers near Talaimannar naval base on northwest coast.
